Utah hosts the Lakers in the Jazz's third game of the 2026-27 season. The Jazz are 1-1, 1-0 at home, and 4th in the Northwest, 1 game back, and 8th in the West, while the Lakers are 1-0, 2nd in the Pacific, and 5th in the West. The season series has no games yet this season, but the Jazz lost all four meetings in 2025-26, including a 131-107 loss in Los Angeles on April 12, 2026.

Utah is without Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise). Los Angeles is missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation), Cameron Carr (oblique strain), and Jake LaRavia (ankle sprain).
